title: DepthProfile
description: Per-persona scenario depth-profile YAML schema mandated by FR-029 (refined under Pass 4 Q20 + Q24 and Pass 5 Q28). One YAML per persona at tests/e2e/web-coverage/_lib/depth-profiles/{persona-id}.depth.yaml; 68 total (matching the FR-002 inventory). The persona spec generator under scripts/web-coverage/_lib/persona_spec_generator.py loads the matching YAML, validates against this schema, and emits a workflow-driven Playwright spec. Missing or invalid profiles open GAP-DEPTH-PROFILE-MISSING per FR-005 and block Capstone Ready per FR-023 (binary CI gate, opt-out forbidden). draft-07 is mandated by Pass 5 Q28 (deliberately distinct from the 2020-12 schemas under contracts/ — ajv must pick the right meta-schema per file).

persona_id.description: Kebab-case persona id. MUST resolve in bootstrap_seed_data().identities (ASM-011 binding via persona-fixture.contract.md). MUST be one of the 68 personas in FR-002's inventory.

workspace_route.description: Primary workspace route the persona enters at scenario start. Drawn from ASM-003's route tree (e.g. /workspaces/[personaId], /incidents/[incidentId], /governance/dashboard/readiness).

safety_critical_workflow.description: Closed enum (12 values) covering FR-029(b) state-changing transitions for write personas (first 9 — approve|publish|allocate|decline|queue-and-sync|escalate|handover|declare|reopen) plus the read-only-persona variants from Pass 4 Q24 (last 3 — observe-tamper-resist|report-generate|export-evidence). Generators MUST NOT silently downgrade a read-only persona to a route-only stub — they MUST realise (a) tamper-attempt + read-back, (b) audit-derivative report-generate + export, or (c) briefing-acknowledgement when one of the read-only enum values is selected.

workflow_steps.description: Ordered list of UI / API actions the generated spec drives. Each step ends in an assertion against expected_response_status.

action.description: Imperative description of the step (e.g. 'click approve button', 'submit AWS draft', 'PATCH /api/incidents/{id}'). Free-form for human readability; the generator translates approved verb prefixes into Playwright primitives.

target_selector.description: Either a Playwright role/label/test-id locator (e.g. 'getByRole:button:Approve') or an HTTP route ('PATCH:/api/incidents/{id}'). Generator forbids raw CSS selectors per plan.md §Page-object responsibilities.

expected_response_status.description: HTTP status the step MUST observe (e.g. 200 for approval, 201 for publish, 403 for tamper-attempt, 409 for stale-state retry). Tamper-attempt steps under safety_critical_workflow=observe-tamper-resist MUST list 403 or 409.

assertion_targets.description: Where the generated spec asserts the post-transition state. AT LEAST ONE of evaluator_endpoint or ui_selector MUST be present (oneOf below).

evaluator_endpoint.description: Bound to FR-028 routable range per Pass 5 Q29 — sc-001..sc-005 only. SC-006..SC-011 are CI-artefact-derived and have no evaluator endpoint; using them here MUST fail schema validation.

ui_selector.description: Playwright locator (role/label/test-id) on which the post-transition persisted state is asserted. Mutually inclusive with evaluator_endpoint — both MAY be present.

audit_correlation_id_source.description: Where the spec retrieves the X-Correlation-Id used for the /api/audit/list read-back: from the response header (preferred, set by FastAPI middleware) or from the response body (legacy paths only).

capstone_outcome.description: Capstone outcome 1..5 per FR-016 (1=lives saved, 2=signal-to-action, 3=evac uplift, 4=logistics, 5=economic loss). Drives @outcome:N tag emission and coverage-trace.md row keying.

hazard.description: Constitution §III hazard catalogue. Single primary hazard for this persona's depth profile; multi-hazard reach is recorded via the @hazard:* tags emitted by the generator from the matching HazardScenarioFixture.

multilingual_variant.description: Optional BCP-47 tag per FR-014 / Clarif Q2 (e.g. 'en', 'zh-Hans', 'aus-x-atsi-placeholder'). Missing variants are NOT a gate failure (Q20). Unrecognised tags fail schema validation; canonical ATSI selection deferred per plan-phase research.md R-008.

coverage_tags.description: Optional cross-jurisdiction reach tags per Pass 4 Q23 (folder placement pivots on owning persona; this field records the multi-jurisdiction reach without breaking the FR-001 file-naming convention). Used by web-coverage-gate to verify SC-007 (cross-jurisdiction coverage).
